meta.name: app-store-optimization
meta.description: Complete App Store Optimization (ASO) toolkit for researching, optimizing, and tracking mobile app performance on Apple App Store and Google Play Store

copy.tagline: 研究、优化并追踪应用在应用商店的表现
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在运营移动应用并希望提升应用商店排名和下载量
copy.tagline_en: Research, optimize, and track your app's performance on app stores
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage mobile apps and want to improve app store rankings and downloads

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你研究关键词、分析竞争对手、优化应用标题和描述、管理评分评论、制定发布策略，并计算 ASO 健康分数。
howto.when: 当你询问关于 App Store 或 Google Play 商店的优化建议，比如关键词研究、元数据优化、竞争对手分析、评论分析或 ASO 评分时触发。

say.text: 帮我研究一下生产力类应用的关键词，找搜索量大但竞争小的。
say.note: Claude 会分析关键词并给出推荐列表。

say.text: 优化我的应用在苹果商店的元数据，我想排在“任务管理”前面。
say.note: Claude 会生成符合字符限制的标题、副标题和描述。

say.text: 分析 Todoist 和 Any.do 的 ASO 策略，找出机会点。
say.note: Claude 会对比它们的元数据、关键词和视觉素材。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you research keywords, analyze competitors, optimize app titles and descriptions, manage ratings and reviews, plan launch strategies, and calculate ASO health scores.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for App Store or Google Play optimization advice, such as keyword research, metadata optimization, competitor analysis, review analysis, or ASO scoring.

say_en.text: Research keywords for a productivity app, find high volume but low competition ones.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze keywords and provide recommendations.

say_en.text: Optimize my app's metadata for Apple App Store, I want to rank for 'task management'.
say_en.note: Claude will generate title, subtitle, and description within character limits.

say_en.text: Analyze ASO strategies of Todoist and Any.do, find opportunities.
say_en.note: Claude will compare their metadata, keywords, and visual assets.
